guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 深井環向受力、水壓回復與分段襯砌接縫。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Deep-shaft ring action, groundwater recovery and staged lining joints. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 合成教學假設：同一方向總應力 σ=900 kPa、孔壓 u=300 kPa，σ′=σ−u=600 kPa
合成教學假設：外壓 p=0.4 MPa、半徑 R=4 m、厚度 t=0.5 m，N=pR=1.6 MN/m，平均 σ=N/t=3.2 MPa
合成教學假設：內半徑 a=4 m、外半徑 b=5 m、均勻外壓 p=0.4 MPa且內壓為零，σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa，負號代表受壓
合成教學假設：混凝土單位重 γ=24 kN/m³、內外半徑4與4.5 m、段高 h=3 m，自重 W=γπ(4.5²−4²)h=961 kN
合成教學假設：水密設計教學水頭 h=60 m、水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa
合成教學假設：假設完全拘束、E=20 GPa、α=1×10⁻⁵/K、降溫ΔT=15 K，σ=EαΔT=3 MPa
factsEn: Synthetic teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=900 kPa and pore pressure u=300 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=600 kPa
Synthetic teaching assumptions: With p=0.4 MPa, R=4 m and t=0.5 m, N=pR=1.6 MN/m and mean σ=N/t=3.2 MPa
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a=4 m, b=5 m, external p=0.4 MPa and zero internal pressure, σθ(a)=−2pb²/(b²−a²)=−2.22 MPa, with compression negative
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For γ=24 kN/m³, radii 4 and 4.5 m and lift height h=3 m, W=γπ(4.5²−4²)h=961 kN
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For teaching head h=60 m, water density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s², p=ρgh=588600 Pa=589 kPa
Synthetic teaching assumptions: Assuming full restraint, E=20 GPa, α=1×10⁻⁵/K and cooling ΔT=15 K, σ=EαΔT=3 MPa

2017 — CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference
2018 — CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction
2026 — This curriculum recalculates original unit-bearing examples and sensitivity, separating public facts from teaching assumptions

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：深豎井襯砌施工
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Deep-shaft lining construction
guides.concept: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。
guides.conceptEn: Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring.
procedure: 開挖降低井壁側向拘束，土骨架與孔隙水卻不是同一條荷載路徑。有效應力決定摩擦強度及變形，水壓另對不透水襯砌施力；因此從總應力扣去孔壓後，不能在襯砌設計中再把水力作用刪除。施工抽水與長期回復需分成不同階段，並核對應力方向及量測深度是否一致。
圓形襯砌可把近似均勻徑向外壓轉成環向壓力，這是圓井結構效率的來源。薄環模型假設厚度相對半徑小、斷面圓整且受壓連續；局部井口、設備孔洞或不均勻岩壓會破壞此假設。環向壓力只能描述平均膜力，不能替代偏心、裂縫、接縫轉動與局部彎矩的檢查。
襯砌較厚時，環向應力沿半徑並不均勻；以整個厚度平均值評估內緣會漏掉應力集中。拉梅解把內外表面的徑向壓力邊界同時納入，適用於均質彈性圓筒的軸對稱狀態。分塊接縫、開裂及非均勻地層作用會改變剛度與接觸，須另用含接縫的模型判讀，不能把解析解當成完整承載能力。
每一段新澆襯砌的自重先經施工接縫、支承環或臨時支承傳遞，不能假設未達強度的下段立刻承擔全部重量。粗糙接面可提供摩擦與剪力傳遞，但其能力與法向壓力、鋼筋連續性及施工品質有關。井壁與岩面若存在滑移或脫空，自重分配也會改變，施工階段的支承路徑因此必須單獨畫出。
止水帶的作用是延長或封閉接縫滲流路徑，效果同時取決於埋設位置、連續接合及兩側混凝土密實度。外部水頭提高時，微小缺口也可能成為集中滲漏路徑。接縫張開、錯位與材料老化會影響止水能力，故不能把混凝土本體抗滲結果直接當作施工縫性能，必須把位移與水壓共同納入試驗邊界。
水化熱提高厚襯砌核心溫度，後續降溫卻受到先澆段及岩面的拘束，於是自由收縮轉變為拉應力。材料在早齡期的彈性模數、抗拉強度與潛變都隨時間改變，完全拘束的彈性式僅提供上限量級。把溫差與齡期分開看會漏掉最弱時刻，因此須同時記錄溫度歷程、養護條件及接縫拘束。
襯砌外側背填的功能是建立地層與圓環之間的接觸，空隙會讓原本分散的徑向作用集中到空隙兩端。局部襯砌此時近似跨越缺口的板帶，彎曲需求隨未支承長度平方增長。簡支梁只是診斷用量級，真實曲率、軸向壓力與兩側彈性支承會改變結果，灌漿壓力本身也可能額外推動襯砌。
保護層隔開鋼筋與水分及侵蝕介質，也決定鋼筋到受壓邊緣的有效深度。增加保護層可能改善耐久性，卻會縮短內力力臂，改變裂縫分布及彎曲容量。曲面襯砌中，鋼筋籠偏心及局部墊塊位移常使設計厚度無法直接代表有效深度，必須對照實測鋼筋位置與真正受拉側。
停抽後含水層的水頭逐步回復，襯砌的永久荷載可能高於施工期間，且不同含水層的回復速率未必相同。若永久設計依賴排水，堵塞、停電及管路隔離就屬重要的失效情境。監測必須區分外部水頭與井內水位，因為作用於襯砌的是兩側壓差，單看抽水機是否運轉無法證明壓差受到控制。
裂縫寬度是某一時刻的狀態，成長率與其對溫度及水頭的反應才有助區分持續變形和可逆開合。相同裂縫在不同季節量測可能有不同寬度，測點位置改變也會造成假趨勢。維護判讀需把裂縫位置、方向、滲水與材料劣化放在同一時間軸，避免把平穩表象誤認為已停止發展。
procedureEn: Excavation removes lateral confinement, but the soil skeleton and pore water follow different load paths. Effective stress controls frictional strength and deformation while water pressure also acts on an impermeable lining. Subtracting pore pressure from total stress therefore does not eliminate hydraulic loading on the lining. Temporary drawdown and long-term recovery require separate stages, with consistent stress directions and measurement depths.

A circular lining converts approximately uniform radial pressure into hoop compression, explaining the efficiency of a round shaft. The thin-ring model assumes a relatively small thickness, a circular section and continuous compression. Openings, penetrations and nonuniform rock loading violate these assumptions. Hoop force describes average membrane action, but it cannot replace checks of eccentricity, cracking, joint rotation or local bending where the load path is interrupted.

In a thick lining, hoop stress varies across the radius, so an average stress can miss the inner-face concentration. The Lamé solution enforces radial-pressure boundaries at both surfaces and applies to a homogeneous elastic cylinder under axisymmetric loading. Segment joints, cracking and uneven ground alter stiffness and contact. They require separate joint-sensitive analysis; the elastic solution estimates a stress distribution rather than a complete structural resistance.

Each new lining lift transfers its weight through construction joints, support rings or temporary supports; the immature lift below cannot automatically carry the full weight. Roughened interfaces transmit friction and shear according to normal pressure, reinforcement continuity and workmanship. Slip or separation against the rock changes the weight distribution. A separate construction-stage load-path diagram is therefore needed instead of assuming that the completed shaft's support system already exists.

A waterstop lengthens or closes the seepage path through a joint, but performance depends on embedment, continuity and concrete consolidation on both sides. A small defect can concentrate leakage as external head rises. Joint opening, offset and ageing also affect sealing. Concrete permeability alone therefore does not establish joint performance; displacement and water pressure must be imposed together when defining a representative qualification test.

Hydration heats the lining core, but subsequent cooling is restrained by earlier lifts and the rock, converting free contraction into tension. Elastic modulus, tensile strength and creep all change at early age, so a fully restrained elastic expression is only a bounding scale. Temperature difference cannot be assessed independently of material age: the weakest stage requires simultaneous temperature histories, curing conditions and realistic joint restraint rather than a final concrete strength alone.

Backfill establishes contact between the ground and lining; a void concentrates formerly distributed radial loading near its edges. The local lining behaves partly like a strip spanning a gap, with bending increasing approximately with the square of unsupported length. A simply supported beam is a diagnostic scale only: curvature, hoop compression and elastic end restraint change the response, while backfill pressure can itself impose additional lining movement.

Cover separates reinforcement from water and aggressive agents while also determining the effective depth measured from the compression face. More cover can improve durability but reduce the internal lever arm and alter crack distribution and bending resistance. In a curved lining, cage eccentricity and displaced spacers mean nominal thickness does not establish effective depth. Measurements must identify actual bar position and the tension face for the relevant bending direction.

After pumping stops, aquifer heads recover and permanent lining loads may exceed construction loads; separate aquifers need not recover at the same rate. If the permanent design relies on drainage, blockage, power loss and pipe isolation become relevant failure scenarios. Monitoring must distinguish external head from the internal shaft water level because differential pressure loads the lining. Pump-running status alone does not establish control of that pressure difference.

Crack width describes one state, while growth rate and response to temperature and water head help distinguish progressive deformation from reversible opening. Seasonal measurements can differ even without permanent damage, and changing gauge locations creates false trends. Maintenance interpretation therefore needs a common time axis for crack position, direction, leakage and material deterioration. An apparently stable isolated reading does not establish that the underlying movement has stopped.
evidence: 設計圖應同時列出施工低水位、設計高水位與排水失效情境；襯砌封閉前，由地工與結構設計者共同確認各階段採用的水壓邊界。
將圓整度偏差、洞口加勁與背填驗收列為同一設計檢查；任何設備開孔變更，須經結構設計者確認環向力如何繞過開口後才施工。
計算書應標出壓力正負號、內外半徑及接觸範圍；以解析解校驗數值模型後，才由結構設計者核准加入孔洞和接縫的工程模型。
每一施工段交接須保存材料齡期、接面處理與支承移除紀錄；臨時工程設計者應簽認拆撐停留點，避免下一段施工自動成為放行依據。
將接頭照片、材料批號與接縫位移需求綁定同一位置編碼；封模前由監造確認止水連續性，缺陷處理須經設計者核准而非只增塗表面材料。
evidenceEn: Show construction drawdown, design high water and drainage failure on the design basis; before lining closure, the geotechnical and structural designers must jointly confirm hydraulic boundaries for each stage.

Review ovality tolerances, opening reinforcement and backfill acceptance together; any revised service penetration requires the structural designer to confirm how hoop force bypasses the opening before construction.

Label pressure signs, radii and contact extent in the calculation; use the analytical solution to verify the numerical model before the structural designer approves the engineering model with openings and joints.

Record material age, interface preparation and support-removal evidence for each lift; the temporary-works designer must release the removal hold point rather than allowing the next construction activity to imply approval.

Link splice photographs, material batch and required joint movement to one location code; inspection must confirm continuity before form closure, and the designer must approve defect repair rather than relying on added surface coating.
pitfalls: 若把有效應力當成襯砌全部外壓，停抽後可能出現未預期裂縫及滲水。水位回升而井內仍乾燥時，壓差會增大，排水暢通的施工觀察不足以證明永久水密安全。
將外徑誤當半徑或忽略內壓，會使厚壁應力分布與實際邊界不符。若接縫張開仍沿用連續圓筒解，局部壓碎及滲水可能被平滑的平均結果掩蓋。
止水帶扭轉、斷接或周邊蜂窩會形成繞流，常見症狀是施工縫局部出水而本體仍乾。只在內表面封堵可能使水改走另一弱面，並掩蓋持續外水壓。
空隙兩端可能先出現彎曲裂縫，過高補漿壓力又可能把裂縫撐大。若耗漿量異常卻沒有追查去向，漿液可能流入裂隙而未填足目標接觸區。
排水管沉積或閥門誤關可能使外壓快速上升，而泵房狀態仍顯示正常。先出現接縫滲漏不表示壓力已安全釋放，局部堵塞與壓力分區可能仍持續增加構件需求。
pitfallsEn: Treating effective stress as the entire lining pressure can produce unexpected cracking and leakage after pumping stops. Rising external water levels increase differential pressure around a dry shaft; successful construction drainage does not establish permanent watertightness.

Using diameter as radius or omitting internal pressure corrupts the boundary solution. Continuing to assume a continuous cylinder after joints open can conceal local crushing and leakage behind a smooth average stress distribution.

Twisting, discontinuous splices or surrounding honeycombing create bypass paths, often producing localized joint leakage while the concrete remains dry. Surface sealing alone may divert flow to another weak interface and conceal sustained external water pressure.

Bending cracks can develop at void edges, while excessive remedial grouting pressure may widen them. Unexplained high grout consumption can mean loss into rock fractures rather than successful filling of the intended contact zone.

Sediment or an incorrectly closed valve can raise external pressure while the pump-room display appears normal. Initial joint leakage does not prove safe pressure relief; local blockage and compartmentalized water can continue increasing lining demand.

related.title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective stress” and “Excavation section”.

history.title: 深豎井襯砌施工
history.text: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1997年：美國陸軍工兵署發布岩石隧道與豎井工程手冊，建立公開工程參考；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2018年：香港發布岩洞工程指南第二版，整理岩洞規劃設計及施工實務。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1997: USACE publishes its rock-tunnel and shaft manual as a public engineering reference; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2018: CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
